title: MiniDAQ 1.0 acceptance specification
comment: What MiniDAQ must show as a whole before it is called 1.0 (Chapter 33), each criterion with the requirements it demonstrates, its target, and the evidence file of the release checks that shows it. tools/acceptance.py evaluates every criterion from one OUT directory of tools/release_checks.sh: PASS, FAIL, MISSING (no evidence: never a pass) or STALE (evidence of another commit). The targets are book-level numbers (assumption: confirm with team the values of the scanner's system requirements). Changes to this file go through change control like the SRS.

criteria.what: The acquisition pipeline's throughput, with the coincidence sorter, in the hardened build
criteria.target: median of 5 repetitions at least 20 M singles/s (10 M required, a margin of 2)

criteria.what: The list-mode writer's throughput with fsync at close
criteria.target: the slowest of 3 runs at least 3 M coincidences/s

criteria.what: A long acquisition at the reference rate
criteria.target: 30 minutes at 1 M singles/s: no loss, no fault, complete, memory growth within 1 MiB/h

criteria.what: End-to-end latency at the reference rate
criteria.target: the 99th percentile of every 10 s interval of the soak at most 10 ms

criteria.what: The chain end to end: the server's records against the offline reference, every count balanced between the stages, the daily QC
criteria.target: every check of both acquisitions of tools/e2e.py passes, the records equal to the reference's

criteria.what: The image at the end of the chain
criteria.target: the phantom's radius at half level within 2 mm of 80 mm, center over periphery within 10% of 1

criteria.what: The system test plan, executed on the release build
criteria.target: every test case passed, none skipped

criteria.what: Every verification of a release (SDP section 6) that the release checks run
criteria.target: all four parts end with 'all release checks passed', on the commit of part 1

criteria.what: Every requirement verified, every hazard closed or justified, every anomaly evaluated, the requirements frozen or changed under change control
criteria.target: the checks docs.trace, docs.risk, docs.anomalies and docs.baseline pass on the commit
